title: ternary-deployment-decision-canvas
content:
Context:
This is a lightweight decision canvas from the Feb 6 workshop with MellorRetail (retail POC). Goal: pick a deployment approach for the initial integration proof-of-concept (target: 6-week run) and surface the key trade-offs we need to validate. Not a final architecture doc — working notes and next steps.

Topline recommendation (workshop consensus):
- Start POC on Hosted (fastest path), run a parallel Dedicated sizing exercise in week 2 if traffic projections cross the committed-cost threshold, and prepare a Private playbook only if Mellor requires data on-prem or strict regional isolation (legal ask).
- Rationale: Hosted minimizes time-to-insight and removes infra friction for first 4 weeks; Dedicated becomes preferable when predictable throughput and cost caps are more important; Private only if regulatory/residency requirements surface.

Key decision axes (scored informally during workshop):
- Latency/SLO need: edge/instore inference required for cashier kiosks (target p95 <= 120ms). Hosted: variable but achievable with region pinning + low-latency model variant. Dedicated: best for predictable p95. Private: best for deterministic network.
- Data residency & compliance: Hosted: supports region selection; not acceptable for Mellor’s cardholder-linked logs. Dedicated: acceptable (dedicated pools, contract). Private: required if cardholder data must not cross customer network.
- Cost predictability: Hosted: pay-as-you-go (high variance). Dedicated: predictable committed monthly. Private: CAPEX/OPEX heavy but predictable after procurement.
- Integration & iteration speed: Hosted: fastest. Dedicated: medium (procurement/infra config). Private: slowest (networking, security review).
- Operational risk & fallbacks: Hosted: multi-region fallback simple. Dedicated: requires capacity planning; fallback to hosted possible if configured. Private: complex failover (depends on customer network).

Assumptions captured during session (to validate ASAP):
- Expected QPS for POC happy path: 2–5 req/s peak per region, average 0.5 req/s.
- Typical payload size: 1–3k tokens per request (chat).
- Target concurrent customers in POC: 10–20 kiosks across 3 regions.
- Billing sensitivity threshold for Mellor: >$15k/month external spend triggers procurement for Dedicated.

Rough cost/latency trade-off table (notes, not formal analysis):
- Hosted: estimated token spend $2–8k/mo for 3-week POC window; p95 latency 80–200ms depending on region and model variant.
- Dedicated: setup + reserved commit approx $12–18k/mo (depends on GPU type); p95 latency 60–120ms; better tail behavior.
- Private: hardware procurement or air-gap: months of lead time; latency best-case 40–90ms but operational overhead high.

Risk log captured (open items):
- R1: Cardholder-related telemetry requirement unclear. Owner: Jordan — due 2025-01-15. Action: obtain exact scope of logs considered PHI/PCI.
- R2: In-store network reliability (some stores have flaky NAT/timeouts). Owner: Marco — due 2025-01-20. Action: test NAT session persistence and TLS handshake times from sample store.
- R3: Model quality variance when using quantized variants. Owner: Sofia — due 2025-01-24. Action: run A/B on top-3 prompts with distilled/quantized models.

POC run plan (6 weeks, high level):
- Week 0 (prep): NDA + initial data access. Provision Hosted sandbox, share API keys, onboarding runbook.
- Week 1 (integration): Connect kiosk telemetry, baseline latency tests, smoke gen tests.
- Week 2 (validation): Traffic run, evaluate costs and tail latency. If projected monthly spend > threshold, trigger Dedicated sizing.
- Week 3–4 (iterate): Quality tuning, caching rules, prompt templates, opt batching.
- Week 5 (scale test): Simulate 3x QPS for resilience.
- Week 6 (handoff): Results deck, recommendation to Mellor: continue Hosted with optimizations OR move to Dedicated (with committed sizing) OR prepare Private roadmap.

Dedicated sizing checklist (what we need if switching):
- Peak simultaneous KV cache size estimate (profiled from hosted logs).
- Average and 95th percentile context length (for memory buffer).
- Burst concurrency profile (5–95th percentile).
- Preferred GPU types and whether quantized variants acceptable.
- SLA targets and failover plan back to hosted.

Private deployment triggers (hard requirements):
- Any contractual clause forcing all inference and logs to stay on-customer-network.
- Requirement for HSM/KMS integration that cannot be achieved over secure connectivity.
- Regulatory audit requiring vendor infrastructure inspection.

Open questions to resolve with Mellor technical leads (these still influenced the recommendation):
- Q1: Can any of the kiosk telemetry be anonymized to allow Hosted? (Jordan)
- Q2: What is the procurement timeline if Mellor requests Dedicated? (Procurement lead)
- Q3: Is there a preferred region for hosting from Mellor’s point-of-view? (Security team)

Immediate action items (next 7 days):
- A1: Get sample telemetry (anonymized) and one week of network traces from 5 stores — OWNER: Jordan — due 2025-01-16.
- A2: Spin up Hosted sandbox with recommended model + cache settings; run scripted p95 tests from three regions — OWNER: Aisha — due 2025-01-13.
- A3: Start Dedicated cost estimate using projected QPS numbers (runback from infra) — OWNER: Marco — due 2025-01-18.

Notes / workshop artifacts:
- Refer to pairing PR with infra team for Dedicated cost model: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/478
- See Confluence sketch for data flows and mask points: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/SEC-POC-329
- Ticket to validate store NAT behavior: JIRA-ENG-842

Decision checkpoints (what will trigger a change in path):
- Checkpoint 1 (end of Week 1): If integration fails due to network restrictions -> escalate to Private readiness track.
- Checkpoint 2 (end of Week 2): If projected monthly hosted spend > $15k -> begin Dedicated sizing + contract conversations.
- Checkpoint 3 (end of Week 4): If model quality regressed under quantization -> keep Hosted and increase reserved compute or propose Dedicated with larger GPU types.

Appendix — quick notes from customer legal (verbatim):
- "We need assurance that any telemetry linked to card transactions will never leave our VPC unless anonymized and approved." — Mellor Legal, 2025-01-05
- "If possible, show a path to on-prem in 3 months; procurement is slow so start Hosted trial now." — Mellor CTO, 2025-01-06

Bottom line: recommended execution is a two-track strategy: launch Hosted POC immediately to unblock product discovery and customer feedback; parallelize Dedicated sizing in week 2 so we can pivot quickly if cost predictability or latency demands require it; only mobilize Private if legal/regulatory constraints mandate on-premises processing.

Comments / call outs:
- This doc intentionally light on final numbers — fill in with telemetry within first 7 days to make a definitive lane choice.
- Keep engineering and sales aligned on the cost trigger to avoid contract surprises.

-- Aisha (notes)
